group.passage:
Robots are found in many places today, from car factories to our living rooms. However, the word “robot” is only about one hundred years old. It first appeared in a play by a writer from the country now called the Czech Republic. The word comes from a Czech word for hard work that people must do whether they like it or not. The name was a perfect [[1]] for the robots in the story, because they were made to do the jobs that humans did not want to do.
The robots in the play were very different from the machines we picture today. Instead of metal parts, they had bodies that looked almost exactly like ours. Factories produced them in large numbers, and soon they [[2]] most of the work in the world. In the end, however, the robots [[3]] their human owners and tried to take control of the world.
The play was a great success and was soon [[4]] into many languages. As a result, the new word entered English and quickly became part of daily speech. Most real robots today look nothing like the ones in the play. Many of them are simply machines that [[5]] the same task again and again without a break.

tags.key_phrase: 過去式敘事中用 were + V-ing

tags.topic: where the word “robot” comes from (a Czech play from the 1920s)

1.explanation_zh: 前一句說 robot 這個字來自一個捷克字，指「不管喜不喜歡都得做的苦工」；because 後面說劇中的機器人正是被造來做人類不想做的工作。字義和角色完全吻合，所以這個名字是「完美的選擇」（a perfect choice）。
evidence: The name was a perfect [[1]] for the robots in the story, because they were made to do the jobs that humans did not want to do.
The word comes from a Czech word for hard work that people must do whether they like it or not.

option_notes_zh.A: mistake（錯誤）：because 後面說明名字和角色正好相符，不是錯誤；「完美的錯誤」也自相矛盾。
option_notes_zh.B: secret（祕密）：文中沒有任何需要保密的事，a perfect secret 和 because 後面的理由接不起來。
option_notes_zh.D: danger（危險）：名字本身不會是危險，because 後面的理由也不是在講危險。

1.strategy_zh: 「a perfect＋名詞＋for…, because…」這類句子，because 後面就是評價的理由；理由是「名字和角色相符」，名詞就要是正面的評價。
hints: 空格要填名詞，前面有 a perfect 修飾。
because 後面是理由：機器人被造來做人類不想做的工作——和前一句說的字義一樣。
名字和角色完全相符，是一個「完美的選擇」。

2.explanation_zh: 這一段用過去式敘述劇情：「Factories produced them in large numbers」。and soon 接著說「不久之後，它們就在做世界上大部分的工作」，時間仍在過去，要用過去時態。四個選項中只有 were doing（過去進行式）是過去時態。
evidence: Factories produced them in large numbers, and soon they [[2]] most of the work in the world.

option_notes_zh.B: 現在進行式：劇情用過去式敘述（produced），and 前後時間一致，不能突然改成現在。
option_notes_zh.C: 未來式：「不久之後」發生在劇情的過去時間裡，不能用未來式。
option_notes_zh.D: 現在完成式：和「現在」有關，不能用來敘述過去故事裡接著發生的事。

2.strategy_zh: 時態題先找同一句已知的動詞時態（produced 是過去式），用 and 連接的動作通常維持同一條時間軸。
hints: 四個選項是同一個動詞的不同時態。
看同一句 and 前面：Factories produced them——已經是過去式。
故事發生在過去，「不久之後正在做」要用過去進行式。

3.explanation_zh: In the end, however 表示劇情轉折：前面說機器人替人類做工，最後卻發生相反的事。空格後還有「and tried to take control of the world」（企圖控制世界），可見機器人「背叛、反抗」了主人。turn against（背叛、轉而對抗）最合適。
evidence: In the end, however, the robots [[3]] their human owners and tried to take control of the world.

option_notes_zh.A: take care of（照顧）：照顧主人和後面的「企圖控制世界」矛盾，也沒有 however 的轉折。
option_notes_zh.B: look up to（尊敬）：尊敬主人卻又企圖控制世界，前後不一致。
option_notes_zh.C: get along with（和…相處融洽）：相處融洽和「企圖奪取控制權」方向相反。

3.strategy_zh: 看到 however 表示轉折，要找和前文相反的發展；再用 and 後面並列的動作（tried to take control）確認方向。
hints: 空格要填片語動詞，受詞是 their human owners。
注意 however，以及 and 後面的 tried to take control of the world。
想控制世界的機器人是「背叛」主人，不是照顧、尊敬或和睦相處。

4.explanation_zh: be translated into＋語言 是固定用法，意思是「被翻譯成某種語言」。下一句說「As a result, the new word entered English」——因為劇本被翻成許多語言，robot 這個字才進入英文。所以填 translated。
evidence: The play was a great success and was soon [[4]] into many languages.
As a result, the new word entered English

option_notes_zh.A: divide into（分成）：是把一個東西分成幾部分，「劇本被分成許多種語言」不合理。
option_notes_zh.B: persuade（說服）：說服的對象是人（persuade someone to…），劇本不能被「說服」進語言裡。
option_notes_zh.D: accuse（指控）：用在指控某人做了某事（accuse someone of…），「劇本被指控成許多種語言」說不通。

4.strategy_zh: 看到「into＋many languages」就想到 translate into；再用下一句的 As a result 確認因果。
hints: 空格要填過去分詞，後面接 into many languages。
下一句說 As a result, the new word entered English——這個字為什麼會進入英文？
劇本被「翻譯」成許多語言，這個字才傳進英文。

5.explanation_zh: 前一句說現實中的機器人大多長得一點也不像劇中的人形機器人；本句說它們很多只是一再重複「執行」同一項工作、毫不休息的機器。perform the same task（執行同一項工作）最合適，without a break（不休息）也說明機器一直在工作。
evidence: Many of them are simply machines that [[5]] the same task again and again without a break.

option_notes_zh.A: avoid（避開）：「一再避開同一項工作、毫不休息」自相矛盾，without a break 表示一直在做。
option_notes_zh.C: refuse（拒絕）：機器「一再拒絕同一項工作」不合它的用途，也和 without a break 矛盾。
option_notes_zh.D: forget（忘記）：「一再忘記同一項工作」說不通。

5.strategy_zh: 句尾的修飾語（again and again、without a break）常是判斷動詞的線索：一直做、不休息，就是在「執行」工作。
hints: 空格要填原形動詞，主詞是關係代名詞 that（指 machines）。
看句尾：again and again without a break——機器一直在做什麼？
機器不休息地一再「執行」同一項工作。

translation_zh.text:
今天很多地方都有機器人，從汽車工廠到我們的客廳都看得到。不過，「robot」這個字只有大約一百年的歷史。它最早出現在一齣戲劇裡，作者來自今天的捷克共和國。這個字源自一個捷克字，指的是不管喜不喜歡都得做的苦工。對劇中的機器人來說，這個名字是完美的選擇，因為它們就是被造來做人類不想做的工作。
劇中的機器人和我們今天想像的機器非常不同。它們沒有金屬零件，身體看起來幾乎和我們一模一樣。工廠大量生產這些機器人，不久之後，世界上大部分的工作都由它們來做。然而到了最後，機器人背叛了它們的人類主人，企圖控制整個世界。
這齣戲大為成功，很快就被翻譯成許多種語言。因此，這個新字進入了英文，並且很快成為日常用語的一部分。現實中的機器人大多長得一點也不像劇中的那些。它們很多只是一再重複執行同一項工作、毫不休息的機器。

evidence: The name was a perfect [[1]] for the robots in the story, because they were made to do the jobs that humans did not want to do.
1.explanation_zh: robot 源自「被迫做的苦工」，正好符合劇中機器人做人類不想做的工作，所以這個名字是「完美的選擇」；a perfect choice 為常見搭配。

evidence: Factories produced them in large numbers, and soon they [[2]] most of the work in the world.
2.explanation_zh: 這段在敘述劇中過去發生的情節（produced 為過去式），soon 之後要用過去式，選 were doing；are doing、will do、have done 時態不合。

evidence: In the end, however, the robots [[3]] their human owners and tried to take control of the world.
3.explanation_zh: however 表轉折，加上後面「試圖控制世界」，機器人是「反抗」主人；turn against 符合，其他三個都是友好或尊敬的意思。

evidence: The play was a great success and was soon [[4]] into many languages.
As a result, the new word entered English and quickly became part of daily speech.
4.explanation_zh: be translated into many languages 是「被翻譯成多種語言」的固定搭配，因此這個字才進入英文。

evidence: Many of them are simply machines that [[5]] the same task again and again without a break.
5.explanation_zh: perform a task 是「執行任務」的搭配，符合現實中機器人不停重複同一工作；avoid、refuse、forget 與「不休息地一再」矛盾。

evidence: The name was a perfect [[1]] for the robots in the story, because they were made to do the jobs that humans did not want to do.
1.explanation_zh: a perfect choice for 表示很適合的名稱。

evidence: Factories produced them in large numbers, and soon they [[2]] most of the work in the world.
2.explanation_zh: 整段敘述劇情用過去式，soon they were doing most of the work。

evidence: In the end, however, the robots [[3]] their human owners and tried to take control of the world.
3.explanation_zh: 機器人想奪取控制權，表示反抗主人，turn against。

evidence: The play was a great success and was soon [[4]] into many languages.
4.explanation_zh: 劇作被翻譯成多種語言，translated into。

evidence: Many of them are simply machines that [[5]] the same task again and again without a break.
5.explanation_zh: 機器反覆執行同一個工作，perform a task。

A.evidence: The name was a perfect [[1]] for the robots in the story, because they were made to do the jobs that humans did not want to do.
A.explanation_zh: mistake（錯誤）：because 後面說明名字和角色正好相符，「完美的錯誤」自相矛盾。

B.evidence: The name was a perfect [[1]] for the robots in the story, because they were made to do the jobs that humans did not want to do.
B.explanation_zh: secret（祕密）：文中沒有要保密的事，because 後面的理由是名字與角色相符，和祕密無關。

D.evidence: The name was a perfect [[1]] for the robots in the story, because they were made to do the jobs that humans did not want to do.
D.explanation_zh: danger（危險）：名字本身不是危險，because 後面的理由也不是在講危險。

B.evidence: Factories produced them in large numbers, and soon they [[2]] most of the work in the world.
B.explanation_zh: are doing（現在進行式）：and 前面的 produced 是過去式，劇情在過去時間軸上敘述，不能突然改成現在式。

C.evidence: Factories produced them in large numbers, and soon they [[2]] most of the work in the world.
C.explanation_zh: will do（未來式）：soon 指劇情過去時間裡的「不久之後」，與 produced 的過去時態不一致。

D.evidence: Factories produced them in large numbers, and soon they [[2]] most of the work in the world.
D.explanation_zh: have done（現在完成式）：和說話的「現在」相關，不能接在過去式 produced 後面敘述過去故事中接著發生的事。

A.evidence: In the end, however, the robots [[3]] their human owners and tried to take control of the world.
A.explanation_zh: took care of（照顧）：和並列的 tried to take control of the world（企圖控制世界）矛盾，也沒有 however 的轉折。

B.evidence: In the end, however, the robots [[3]] their human owners and tried to take control of the world.
B.explanation_zh: looked up to（尊敬）：尊敬主人卻又企圖控制世界，前後不一致。

C.evidence: In the end, however, the robots [[3]] their human owners and tried to take control of the world.
C.explanation_zh: got along with（相處融洽）：與後面「企圖奪取世界的控制權」方向相反。

A.evidence: The play was a great success and was soon [[4]] into many languages.
A.explanation_zh: divided（被分成）：divide into 是把一個整體分成幾部分，「劇本被分成許多種語言」不合理。

B.evidence: The play was a great success and was soon [[4]] into many languages.
B.explanation_zh: persuaded（被說服）：說服的對象是人，劇本不能被「說服」進許多語言。

D.evidence: The play was a great success and was soon [[4]] into many languages.
D.explanation_zh: accused（被指控）：accuse 的對象是人（accuse someone of…），也不和 into many languages 搭配。

A.evidence: Many of them are simply machines that [[5]] the same task again and again without a break.
A.explanation_zh: avoid（避開）：句尾 again and again without a break 表示一直在做，「一再避開、毫不休息」自相矛盾。

C.evidence: Many of them are simply machines that [[5]] the same task again and again without a break.
C.explanation_zh: refuse（拒絕）：機器「毫不休息地一再拒絕同一項工作」與 without a break 矛盾。

D.evidence: Many of them are simply machines that [[5]] the same task again and again without a break.
D.explanation_zh: forget（忘記）：「一再忘記同一項工作而不休息」不合語意。
